regions.region: title, abstract, and introductory prose in both columns
regions.finding: The abstract states the current TFA-promoted hydroarylation claim, while the introduction describes cited prior work; broad claims were not duplicated as batch experiments.

One gold(I)-catalyzed intermolecular hydroarylation arrow with 5 mol% phosphine-gold chloride, 5 mol% AgBF4, CH2Cl2, room temperature, 2 h, and 67% yield; classified as cited literature, not a new experiment.

regions.region: right column Scheme 2, upper and lower arrows
regions.finding: Two distinct generic prior-literature iodoarylation arrows (intramolecular and intermolecular) were retained as separate literature examples; no unstated yields or R-group structures were inferred.
The authors' previously reported PdCl2(MeCN)2-catalyzed hydroarylation arrow was classified as a literature example with its displayed catalyst loading, DMA/TFA ratio, temperature, and time.

unresolved: The cited schemes omit some scales, times, yields, and operational details and use generic R/Ar groups; those values remain missing.
No Supporting Information file was explicitly associated.

regions.region: upper-right Table 1 reaction drawing, entries 1-11, and footnotes
regions.finding: All eleven optimization rows were extracted independently, including co-solvent/TFA volumes, catalyst identities, negative-free temperature values, NMR main-isomer yields, parenthetical isolated yields, Z/E ratios, and recovered 1a footnotes.

regions.region: left-column Results and Discussion adjacent to Table 1
regions.finding: The prose-specific 9% NMR yield of (E)-3h in entry 1 and chromatographic separation statement were reconciled with the table record; catalyst addition and temperature trends were retained as context rather than new batches.

regions.region: lower-half Table 2 reaction drawing, entries 1-14, and footnotes
regions.finding: Thirteen new substrate-scope records plus the already represented Table 1 entry 9/Table 2 entry 8 experiment cover every row. Entry 11 preserves an undetermined E/Z ratio; entry 12 preserves no reaction, 45% recovery of 1a, and decomposition of 2k; entry 9 preserves the 4 mmol scale.

unresolved: The main-text tables omit atmosphere, workup, purification, and most masses; SI was not associated.
Most scope products and R-group allenoates retain source labels with null SMILES pending chemical structure review.
Table 1 catalyst loadings are not stated.

regions.region: upper-left continuation of Results and Discussion
regions.finding: Narrative interpretation of Table 1 and Table 2 was used as corroboration only; the repeated 10 °C, 13 h experiment was not duplicated, and the no-reaction alkyl-allenoate conclusion remains attached to Table 2 entry 12.

regions.region: lower-left Table 3 reaction drawing, entries 1-6, and footnotes
regions.finding: Five new E-major substrate-scope records were extracted. Table 3 entry 5 is the same 1a/2h, 80 °C, 11 h experiment as Table 1 entry 11 and was merged into that record; its 5% recovery of 1a was added.

regions.region: right-column Figures 1 and 2 and adjacent structure-assignment prose
regions.finding: ORTEP figures and prose support the Z assignment/connectivity of 3g and the E assignment of 3g; they were linked to the relevant Table 2 entry 7 and Table 3 entry 4 records, not counted as new reactions.
The prose explains acid-sensitive decomposition trends for 5-methyl/5-methoxy substrates and tolerance of 5-bromo substitution; row-level experiments are on page 4.

unresolved: Operational details beyond the Table 3 conditions are absent because SI was not associated.
ORTEP evidence confirms assignments but was not treated as verification of machine-generated SMILES; structures remain unverified.

regions.region: upper-left Table 4 reaction drawing, entries 1-5, and footnotes
regions.finding: All five substituted-indole rows were extracted independently with E/Z order, isolated yield, temperature, time, common quantities, and NMR basis. Footnotes for entries 3 and 4 literally report recovery of 1a although the row substrate is 1d; the identity conflict is preserved and flagged.

regions.region: middle-left Equation (1) and upper-right isomerization prose
regions.finding: A separate experiment converts (Z)-3h to (E)-3h in TFA at 60 °C for 48 h with a reported 41% yield; the unstated yield basis and scale remain missing.
The allene protonation/carbocation/isomerization pathway is explicitly a proposed mechanism and was classified as one mechanism record without assigning experimental yields to its arrows.

regions.region: right-column conclusions, Supporting Information statement, and references opening
regions.finding: No new batch experiment is reported. The paper states that SI contains experimental details and isomerization data, but no SI file was explicitly provided or associated in this workspace.

unresolved: Table 4 recovery footnotes name 1a while entries 3 and 4 use 1d; this source-level discrepancy was not silently corrected.
Equation (1) omits scale, TFA volume, yield basis, atmosphere, workup, and purification.
No Supporting Information file was explicitly associated.

regions.finding: Bibliographic references only; no new current-paper reaction arrows, tables, or batch procedures were found and cited works were not imported as experiments from this paper.

Crystal data and CCDC-800855/CCDC-800854 support the reported Z-3g and E-3g assignments. They were linked as characterization evidence to Table 2 entry 7 and Table 3 entry 4, not counted as reaction experiments.
Publication metadata only; no reaction experiment is present.

unresolved: Crystallographic assignment evidence does not by itself verify the machine record's complete molecular structure; all structures remain unverified.
The references were not followed beyond the bounded PDF pages.
